entities.name: Nguyễn Phúc Khoát
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nguyễn Phúc Khoát was one of the Nguyễn lords who ruled over the southern portion of Vietnam from the 16th-18th centuries. Also known as Chúa Võ (主武) or Võ vương (武王), he continued the southern expansion undertaken by his predecessor, Nguyễn Phúc Trú. Provinces and districts originally belonging to Cambodia were taken by Khoát. The Vietnamese-Cambodian border established by the end of his reign remains the border today. The de jure pretense of loyalty to the Lê dynasty was performed by Khoát.
